verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs show users issuing natural-language commands to @Rootly in Slack that take real actions, such as updating severity, paging teams and converting an incident to private. A conversational AI agent is also available on web and mobile, though the web chat is read-only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language actions work as claimed, and a documented list of which operations natural language can perform outside Slack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: "This is now a SEV1. Update the incident severity." ... "Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident."
mention @Rootly in the channel or thread and ask "catch me up" or "page the database on-call team". Rootly AI always replies in-thread.
Open it on any incident and ask questions in natural language.
On any incident you have access to, the mobile app gives you an Incident Summary card and the conversational Rootly AI agent.
